title: 1947. Maximum Compatibility Score Sum

examples.explanation: We assign students to mentors in the following way: - student 0 to mentor 2 with a compatibility score of 3. - student 1 to mentor 0 with a compatibility score of 2. - student 2 to mentor 1 with a compatibility score of 3. The compatibility score sum is 3 + 2 + 3 = 8.
The compatibility score of any student-mentor pair is 0.
